FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What emergency dental services are available in Durham, NC?

At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Does Riccobene Associates accept new patients at the Durham location?

Yes. We are always happy to welcome new clients who are motivated to take care of their oral health! Please give us a call or schedule an appointment online. We can't wait to see you!

Is pediatric or family dentistry offered in Durham, NC?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.

Can I get cosmetic services like teeth whitening or veneers in Durham?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Does the Durham office offer dental implants?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.

What sedation or anxiety-free dentistry options are available in Durham?

At Durham, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia
